name: kiasi
description: Kiasi keeps Claude Code's context small and its weekly limit long: output caps, turn budgets, refused mega-pastes, deterministic pruning at compaction, sandbox tools that run commands and file analyses out of context, a searchable store of everything it cut, and a local dashboard of what it saved.

output_cap_chars.title: Output cap (chars)
output_cap_chars.description: Reads of transcripts, logs and /tmp files over this many characters are cut and saved in full to the data directory.

turn_budget_mode.title: Turn budget mode
turn_budget_mode.description: pause (the default): at the budget kiasi pauses the turn, refuses further calls and saves the remaining work, so replying continue resumes it. warn: kiasi only warns, before and at the budget. off: no budget; calls are only counted. Subagent budgets follow the same mode.

pause_notification.title: Pause notification
pause_notification.description: A desktop notification when kiasi pauses a turn. auto (the default): only in the VS Code extension and the desktop app, whose chat raises none; the terminal already gets one. always: in every session. off: never.

pause_question.title: Pause question
pause_question.description: At a pause Claude asks how to go on: continue here with a fresh budget, hand the rest to a subagent, or stop. auto (the default): where a question can be shown, in the terminal, the VS Code extension and the desktop app. always: in every session. off: the turn ends with the pause notice.

turn_call_budget.title: Turn call budget
turn_call_budget.description: Tool calls allowed in one turn before kiasi pauses it (see Turn budget mode). The warning comes 10 calls earlier.

turn_token_budget.title: Turn token budget
turn_token_budget.description: Tokens one turn may re-read before kiasi pauses it, whichever of this and the call budget comes first. The warning comes at 80%.

subagent_call_budget.title: Subagent call budget
subagent_call_budget.description: Tool calls one subagent may make before kiasi pauses it and it hands the remaining work back to its caller.

paste_refusal_chars.title: Paste refusal size (chars)
paste_refusal_chars.description: Pasted prompts over this size are refused outright: saved to disk, dropped from the conversation, and Claude is asked to resend the instruction with the path.

compaction_window_text.title: Compaction window
compaction_window_text.description: Shown in the SessionStart warning when CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW is unset. Set that env var yourself; this only controls the wording of the reminder.
